capability.note: Guarded runtime code is implemented and unit-tested; this static registry does not authorize activation or claim deployed verification. Mutations require server signatures and an initialized store; fixed-scope runtime reload additionally requires explicit enablement, safe-idle evidence and exact readback. Default configuration remains disabled. Native/deployment tests and physical acceptance are deferred.

limitations: No live robot/SBC inventory was read: installed package versions are not claimed.
No native ROS node was run: no hotload/live mutability is proven.
No commissioned usable lower performance bound is known for either speed ceiling.
Candidate bounds below are proposals for review, not approved commissioning ranges.

hard_envelope.note: Fixed, source-backed hard upper bounds. These are ceilings, never commanded speeds. The commissioned usable lower bound is UNKNOWN and deliberately null; do not infer one.

package_version_evidence.detail: Slice 1 records source provenance only. No pinned Nav2/AMCL package version or native node behavior test was performed, and no claim is made about the installed robot. Add pinned versions and native readback proof before any live-mutability claim.
package_version_evidence.docker_base: docker/Dockerfile uses FROM ros:${ROS_DISTRO}-ros-base with ROS_DISTRO default jazzy; the exact apt package versions are not pinned in-repo.

parameters.label: Maximum linear speed

bounds.note: 0.0 is only the structural magnitude floor. The commissioned usable lower bound is unknown and NOT asserted.

side_effects: Bounds both manual (F710/web/keyboard via final smoother) and Nav2 output through the final teleop_velocity_smoother.

evidence.detail: smoother.yaml max_velocity[0] and contracts/web-teleop.json velocity_limits.linear_m_s.max agree on 0.30.

parameters.label: Maximum angular speed

bounds.note: 0.0 is only the structural magnitude floor. The commissioned usable lower bound is unknown and NOT asserted.

side_effects: The SBC classifyDrive accepts up to 1.20 rad/s, but the commissioned final cap is 0.70 rad/s and must not be raised from here.

evidence.detail: smoother.yaml max_velocity[2] and contracts/web-teleop.json velocity_limits.angular_rad_s.max agree on 0.70.

parameters.label: AMCL maximum particle count

parameters.label: AMCL evaluated beams per update

bounds.note: Robot CPU/sampling budget 8–360; upstream laser models require at least 2 beams. These are not universal ROS upper bounds. More beams cost CPU.

side_effects: More beams increase CPU per update.

evidence.detail: nav2_params.yaml amcl.max_beams; comment: required by likelihood_field_prob.

parameters.label: AMCL target filter error

bounds.note: Candidate only; must be strictly positive.

side_effects: Interacts with KLD sampling particle count.

parameters.label: AMCL filter population quantile z

bounds.note: Positive population quantile multiplier, not a probability capped at 1. Nav2 Jazzy documents 2.33 as the 99th percentile; no universal upper bound is published. YAML starting value remains 0.99.

side_effects: Interacts with KLD sampling particle count.

parameters.label: AMCL laser hit Gaussian sigma

bounds.note: Nav2 Gaussian-model standard deviation must be positive (sigma appears in a denominator). The upper limit 1.0 is the robot edit policy, not a universal ROS bound. See docs/tuning-parameter-rules.md.

side_effects: Only meaningful for the configured laser model; re-validate localization after any change.

parameters.label: Nav2 RPP in-place rotation angular target

bounds.note: Candidate only. This is not a cap on all curved-path angular output; a downstream bound remains mandatory.

dependencies.note: requested values must not exceed the commissioned angular cap

side_effects: Recorded upstream default 0.9 rad/s EXCEEDS the 0.70 rad/s commissioned cap; this inconsistency is recorded, not silently clamped.

parameters.label: Nav2 RPP final-approach minimum speed

bounds.note: Nav2 Jazzy documents min_approach_linear_velocity > 0.01 m/s. The upper limit 0.30 and cruise dependency are robot policy. YAML starting value remains 0.08. See docs/tuning-parameter-rules.md.

dependencies.note: approach minimum must not exceed the cruise target

side_effects: Keep above the base deadband so final approach still actuates; obstacle/approach slowdowns remain in force.

parameters.label: Nav2 RPP approach slowdown distance

bounds.note: Robot policy enforces the Nav2 recommendation: less than half the local costmap width (current YAML width 3 m). This is a geometry-specific policy, not a universal ROS numeric bound; YAML starting value remains 0.6.

side_effects: Larger values start the final slowdown earlier.

parameters.label: Nav2 velocity smoother linear max

bounds.note: Candidate only; below the global ceiling in source.

dependencies.note: Nav2 smoother must not exceed the global ceiling

side_effects: Bounds Nav2 forward output only; manual output is bounded by the final teleop_velocity_smoother.

parameters.label: Nav2 velocity smoother angular max

bounds.note: Candidate only.

dependencies.note: Nav2 smoother must not exceed the commissioned angular cap

side_effects: Recorded upstream default 1.0 rad/s EXCEEDS the 0.70 rad/s commissioned cap; the downstream final smoother still clamps, but this inconsistency must be mapped explicitly, not hidden.

evidence.detail: nav2_params.yaml velocity_smoother.max_velocity[2] = 1.0, above the final smoother 0.70.
